newsitem.title: INDIA: BTR unit plans to make motors in India.
newsitem.headline: BTR unit plans to make motors in India.

text.p: Indian electrical equipment firm Crompton Greaves and electric motors maker Brook Hansen, a unit of BTR Plc of U.K., announced on Wednesday a joint venture firm to manufacture motors in India.
BTR Plc owns 13 percent of Crompton Greaves.
The joint venture will manufacture energy efficient motors using Brook Hansen's patented technology, a statement said.
Paul Buysse, BTR executive director responsible for power drives group, told reporters the new firm will be an important new manufacturing base for the BTR's power drives group.
CG-Brook Hansen, the new firm, will be 51 percent owned by Brook Hansen and 49 percent by Crompton Greaves.
"The capital investment will be approximately 290 million in the next five years, with a targeted sales turnover of 850 million in the fifth year," the joint statement said.
The new firm will export 70 percent of the production and the balance will be sold in the local market, Crompton Greaves managing director K.K. Nohria said.
